newsitem.title: CHINA: China to restructure onshore oil industry.
newsitem.headline: China to restructure onshore oil industry.

text.p: China National Petroleum Corp will restructure its onshore oil operations, separating oil exploration and production from technical services and its other non-oil businesses, the official China Daily said on Thursday.
The newspaper said the aim of the move by the big oil industry company was to accelerate the transition to a market economy from central planning.
"A crucial part of the restructuring will be to make the industry more efficient and flexible," the newspaper said.
Market analysts said the restructuring would facilitate the floatation of shares.
"The restructuring ... will separate oil exploration and production from technical services and logistics, hospitals and schools and all the other non-oil businesses," it said.

The newspaper said officials have commended the Tarim and Turpan-Hami oilfields in the northwestern region of Xinjiang, where specialised companies are chosen through nationwide competitive bidding to conduct technical service projects such as drilling and logging.
